SELECT age, avg(try_cast(individualrate AS double)) AS avg_monthly_premium FROM govblock_health.marketplace_rate_puf WHERE statecode = 'GA' AND cast(businessyear AS varchar) = '2021' AND age IN ('21', '64') AND tobacco <> 'Tobacco User' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which papers from 2012, the year the Higgs boson was found, have been cited most?
SELECT title, try_cast(citation_count AS integer) AS citations FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_literature WHERE substr(earliest_date, 1, 4) = '2012' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many NSF awards took effect each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT substr(awardeffectivedate, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS awards FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards WHERE substr(awardeffectivedate, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which kinds of relationship connect one Rhea reaction to another?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea_relationships WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people do active community water systems in New York serve?

SELECT sum(try_cast(population_served_count AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS' AND primacy_agency_code = 'NY'
Which kinds of Treasury securities carried the highest average interest rate in September 2025?
SELECT security_desc, try_cast(avg_interest_rate_amt AS double) AS rate FROM govblock_treasury.avg_interest_rates WHERE record_date = '2025-09-30' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the average rotor diameter of wind turbines built in 2022?
SELECT avg(try_cast(t_rd AS double)) AS avg_rotor_diameter_m FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE cast(p_year AS varchar) = '2022'
Which lines of cover draw the most complaints in Texas, from homeowners to auto?
SELECT coverage_level, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_insurance_filings.tx_insurance_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many approved drugs can be taken by mouth?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_molecule_dictionary WHERE max_phase = 4 AND oral = 1
Which states drew the most NIH research dollars in 2021?
SELECT org_state, sum(try_cast(total_cost AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE cast(fy AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubMed papers are indexed under hemoglobins?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE descriptor_name = 'Hemoglobins'
Which states recorded the most births in 2024?
SELECT stname, try_cast(births2024 AS double) AS births FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many political action committees are based in Washington, D.C.?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees WHERE cmte_st = 'DC'
Which kinds of magnetic ordering are most common among computed materials?
SELECT ordering, count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT definition FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compounds WHERE name = 'caffeine'
Which kinds of air permits are most common among EPA-tracked facilities?
SELECT caa_permit_types, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL AND caa_permit_types IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did Pfizer pay doctors and teaching hospitals in 2020?

SELECT sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE submitting_applicable_manufacturer_or_applicable_gpo_name LIKE 'Pfizer%' AND cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2020'
Which contaminants are behind the most drinking water violations?

SELECT r.value_description, count(DISTINCT v.violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement AS v JOIN govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_ref_code_values AS r ON r.value_code = v.contaminant_code AND r.value_type LIKE 'CONTAMINANT%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Were more patent applications filed in 2015 or in 2023?
SELECT substr(filing_date, 6, 4) AS year, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 WHERE substr(filing_date, 6, 4) IN ('2015', '2023') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which counties are split among the most ZIP code areas?
SELECT namelsad_county_20, geoid_county_20, count(DISTINCT geoid_zcta5_20) AS zip_areas FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
What did households in New York pay per kilowatt-hour of electricity on average in 2024?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS cents_per_kwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.PRICE.NY-RES.A' AND period = '2024'
Which subsidized housing projects in California are the largest?
SELECT name, program_label, try_cast(total_units AS double) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE states = 'CA California' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many health-based drinking water violations began in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_health_based_ind = 'Y' AND substr(non_compl_per_begin_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which kinds of cross-reference does ChEBI record most often?
SELECT type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_database_accession WHERE type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is New York State's estimated population for 2025?
SELECT try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' AND stname = 'New York'
Which industries had the most women-owned small business set-asides posted on SAM.gov?
SELECT naicscode, count(*) AS notices FROM govblock_awards.sam_opportunities WHERE setaside LIKE '%Women%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the title of patent US-5153197-A?
SELECT patent_number, title, publication_date FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_patents WHERE patent_number = 'US-5153197-A'
What share of single audits raise doubt about the organisation continuing as a going concern?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_going_concern_included AS varchar), 1, 1)) IN ('Y', 'T') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_general
How many wholesale power contracts did Lakeside Syracuse LLC report?
SELECT count(DISTINCT contract_unique_id) AS contracts FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_contracts WHERE seller_company_name = 'Lakeside Syracuse LLC'
How much did New York's average nuclear output fall between 2020 and 2022, after Indian Point closed?

SELECT substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) AS year, round(avg(try_cast(gen_mw AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE fuel_category = 'Nuclear' AND substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) IN ('2020', '2022') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
